final.summary: Outfall pH stayed near neutral and power matched load with physical meter confirmation, but conductivity fell sharply while outfall flow was missing. The tank balance also shows a shortfall that cannot be checked without the missing outfall record. The evidence cannot separate dilution or meter error from normal operation.

explanations.label: Normal operation: batch wastewater treated through working ETP
Bypass: untreated wastewater sent around ETP to outfall
Aeration cut: ETP inflow passed but blowers/power cut
Dilution: groundwater added to outfall masking effluent
Meter fault: one or more feeds unreliable for the stretch

key_evidence.why: Outfall pH stayed near neutral with max 7.83, showing no raw alkaline water reached the outfall.
Conductivity fell from around 5726 to around 3766 then recovered, suggesting extra low-conductivity water at the outfall.
Outfall flow missing from 2026-10-13 10:30 to 2026-10-14 02:10, so extra flow cannot be confirmed or ruled out.
Tank balance shows 212.3 m3 unaccounted against tolerance 191.5 m3, indicating water left by another route or intake never became wastewater.
Power averaged 54.4 kW against 58.4 kW expected with only 0.012 share below band, showing aeration load was met.
Power photo 60.3 kW matches feed and sits within expected band, providing physical evidence aeration ran.
Inflow photo 67.3 m3/h matches feed, providing physical evidence inflow reading is correct.
Power shows no identical repeat of prior day, ruling out replayed power feed hiding a cut.
Lab BOD 13.1 mg/L below 30 limit at 14:30 shows treatment worked at sample time.

final.scope_line: Based on flow, power, pH and conductivity records for 2026-10-13 10:00 to 2026-10-14 14:00. Does not measure every pollutant.
limitations: Outfall flow missing over the conductivity drop prevents separating dilution from flow meter error.
ETP and boundary balances cannot be computed with 44% outfall coverage, so treated flow versus outfall cannot be checked.
Power confirms flow only roughly and a flat inflow meter can still sit inside the band.
Logbook claim of normal operation is a factory claim, not a fact.
No replay check was possible for S2 within the check budget.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
